slides.texte_overlay:
things that instantly make
you more interesting

an unusual hobby

pick up one strange hobby, like fencing, beekeeping or calligraphy. people are always curious about someone with a hobby they've never heard of before.

real thoughts about books

read a few books that move you and form real opinions about them. people love talking to someone who reads widely and actually thinks about what they read.

stories with a twist

practise telling short stories with a beginning, a twist and an ending. a good storyteller is magnetic at any table, and anyone can learn to do it well.

odd little facts

odd facts are the fastest way to become interesting, and collecting them takes only minutes a day. one strange fact can easily carry an entire conversation.
slides.texte_sophia:
odd little facts

collect odd facts, like why cats purr. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and 5 minutes of odd facts is the fastest way to become interesting.

slides.texte_overlay:
curiosity about others

ask people about their lives and really listen to the answers. the most interesting people are almost always the most interested in everyone else around them.
